description: AST-level mutations identified for the intervallib package. Each mutation is a single-token semantic change produced by standard mutation operators (comparison boundary swaps, arithmetic operator replacements, operand substitutions).

mutations.description: Replace first '<' with '<=' in overlap check
Replace second '<' with '<=' in overlap check
Replace '<=' with '<' in adjacent-interval merge condition
Replace '-' with '+' in coverage accumulation (ce - cs -> ce + cs)
Replace '-' with '+' in coverage denominator (hi - lo -> hi + lo)
Replace '<=' with '<' in binary search for latest non-conflicting job
Replace '+=' with '=' in time accumulation (time += proc_time -> time = proc_time)
Replace '>' with '>=' in earliest-start update condition
Replace '>' with '>=' in upper-bound tightening condition
Replace '>=' with '>' in first part of feasibility check (dp[0] >= dp[1] -> dp[0] > dp[1])
Replace '<' with '<=' in slot iteration bound (while t < time_end -> while t <= time_end)
Replace '>' with '>=' in overload detection (load > capacity -> load >= capacity)
Replace '>=' with '>' in capacity check (len(active) >= resource_capacity -> len(active) > resource_capacity)
